## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

The *Duggatikathā* (Kv 12.9) is a debate section in the twelfth chapter of the *Kathāvatthu*, the fifth treatise of the Abhidhamma Piṭaka [Catalog]. The controversy revolves around the thesis *diṭṭhisampannassa puggalassa pahīnā duggatī ti* ("Is a person possessing right view free from birth in a lower form of existence?"), a proposition associated in the tradition with the Uttarāpathakas [Dutt 1978].
